extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value approached by f(x) as x approaches a.

extracted_concepts.name: One-sided Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit from the left or right side.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit at Infinity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit as x grows without bound.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity at a Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is continuous at a if lim_{x→a} f(x) = f(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Removable Discontinuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Discontinuity where the limit exists but the function value is missing or mismatched.

extracted_concepts.name: Horizontal Asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line approached by a function as x → ±∞.

extracted_concepts.name: Vertical Asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line approached near a point where the function is undefined.

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g(x) ≤ f(x) ≤ h(x) and lim g = lim h = L, then lim f = L.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit Laws
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum, product, and quotient rules for limits.

extracted_concepts.name: Average Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Change in a function over an interval.

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change at a single instant.

extracted_concepts.name: Secant Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line through two points on a curve.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line touching a curve at a point with slope given by the derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Property that a derivative exists at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(xⁿ) = nxⁿ⁻¹.

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (fg)' = f'g + fg'.

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (f/g)' = (f'g - fg')/g².

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiating equations not solved for y.

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse Function Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If y = f(x) and x = g(y), then g'(y) = 1/f'(g(y)).

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives beyond the first, such as f'', f''', f⁽ⁿ⁾.

extracted_concepts.name: Related Rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relating rates of quantities that change with time.

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: For 0/0 or ∞/∞: lim f/g = lim f'/g'.

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A continuous function on [a,b] has absolute max/min.

extracted_concepts.name: Critical Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point where f' = 0 or f' is undefined.

extracted_concepts.name: First Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Classify critical points using sign changes of f'.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'(c) = 0 and f''(c) > 0 implies local minimum.

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'' > 0 gives concave up; f'' < 0 gives concave down.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find maximum or minimum subject to constraints.

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximation of area using left, right, or midpoint sums.

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∫_a^b f(x)dx = lim Σ f(xᵢ*)Δx.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∫_a^b f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Substitution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Integration method that reverses the chain rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation involving derivatives.

extracted_relations.evidence: Continuous if limit equals function value
Limit exists but value is missing or mismatched
Asymptote comes from limits at infinity
Rates are derivatives with respect to time
Integral is limit of Riemann sums
u-substitution is chain rule in reverse
